description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand, and causing target opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
